source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #340 (#312, canonical ABI loads and stores trap on unaligned pointers, and the canon-lower trampoline preserves the trap cause instead of flattening it to unreachable). The branch merged current main first (merge commit c6a91b57e3bb14ed60e513f4e97ace7a7248a322, main at 3acb5566b26769d7b9d1cd11838c87ff2391acca; PRs #326, #336, #337, #338 and #339) and carries one test-only integration follow-up (7294a40: the #312 regression fixtures modernised to the strict component WAT syntax required by the wast 263 bump from PR #326, values/alignment.wast re-enabled in the vendored upstream suite, and the stale #312 citation dropped from values/realloc.wast's exclusion reason). Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone three times (workflow_dispatch runs 45553891986, 45553905012 and 45553917777 on main at 3acb5566b26769d7b9d1cd11838c87ff2391acca; all three runs pass the gate). The main control reproduces the checked-in baseline exactly on 20 of the 32 gated series; on the remaining 12 — the three configurations that link telomere-component (component, wasi, wasi-threads) in both profiles — it measures below the checked-in baseline by exactly PR #336's (#316) shrinkage (release stripped file −2,680 B component, −2,696 B wasi, −2,664 B wasi-threads; stripped .text −2,464 B in each; release-size stripped file −1,568/−1,040/−1,024 B and stripped .text −1,488/−944/−944 B), which was never re-baselined because the gate passes on shrinkage. This PR's own delta against the main control is confined to the same 12 series: in release, stripped file +1,248 B in component and +1,264 B in wasi and wasi-threads, stripped .text +368 B in each; in release-size, stripped file +1,296/+1,312/+1,328 B and stripped .text +1,008/+1,008/+1,024 B. Every other configuration is byte-identical to main in both profiles. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the four branch samples and across the three main samples. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is now the release component stripped file series at +9.90% (2,433,656 B to 2,674,496 B), down from +9.96% because PR #336's shrinkage is now reflected in the baseline; the release core-nosimd stripped file series stays at +9.83% (1,275,448 B to 1,400,840 B). The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison.
